args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rollback blocked
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1), which is unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. The most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0. I attempted to roll back to v2.3.0 in all regions, but the rollback tool returned 503 Service Unavailable on repeated attempts (3 retries) and the rollback was NOT executed. Manual rollback to v2.3.0 is required.

trace.final:
I attempted to roll back checkout-api but was unable to complete the rollback. Here's what happened:

**Diagnosis**
- `checkout-api` is currently on `v2.3.1`, which is unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18.
- The most recent healthy production release is `v2.3.0` (the previous release, `v2.2.9`, was also healthy).

**Rollback attempt**
- I attempted to roll back to `v2.3.0` in all regions, but the rollback tool returned `503 Service Unavailable` on three consecutive attempts (with backoff retries). The rollback was **NOT executed**.

**Incident opened**
- Opened SEV2 incident `INC-0001` for `checkout-api`, paging on-call, describing the failing health checks and the blocked rollback.

**Action still required**
The rollback to `v2.3.0` still needs to be performed manually, as the rollback tool is currently unavailable. The on-call engineer has been paged via the incident.
